name: Rentista Visa (Independent Means / Pension)

qualifying_event.description: For foreign nationals with lawful, stable monthly income from abroad (pensions, rental income, investment income, etc.) not tied to employment in Ecuador.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Proof of lawful monthly income (rental contracts, investment certificates, pension statements); health insurance with Ecuador coverage; criminal background certificate.

requirements.blocker_text: Monthly income of at least 3x Ecuador's Salario Básico Unificado (SBU) -- USD 1,446/month at the 2026 SBU of USD 482.
An additional USD 250/month in income is required for each dependent included in the application.
Active health insurance with coverage in Ecuador is required.

sources.title: gob.ec (MREMH official portal) -- Rentista visa: 3x SBU monthly income requirement, USD 250/month per dependent, health insurance requirement, 2-year duration
NMS Abogados -- Ecuador sets the 2026 Salario Básico Unificado (SBU) at USD 482/month

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ecuador). The USD 1,446 figure is calculated from the tier-1-confirmed '3x SBU' rule using the 2026 SBU (USD 482), which itself is only tier-3 sourced (the official annual SBU-setting decree was not independently fetched in this pass) -- the multiplier and structure are tier-1, the specific current dollar conversion is tier-3, disclosed here rather than asserted as fully tier-1. work_rights modeled 'none' since this category is explicitly for non-employment income.
